maddeler.e:
أنسحب (form VII)
# أَنْسَحِبُ (ʔansaḥibu) /ʔan.sa.ħi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْسَحَبَ (insaḥaba)
# أَنْسَحِبَ (ʔansaḥiba) /ʔan.sa.ħi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَحَبَ (insaḥaba)
# أَنْسَحِبْ (ʔansaḥib) /ʔan.sa.ħib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْسَحَبَ (insaḥaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
